items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: Marl is running for President of the Union... I marvel at people like Marl... He's the type of guy that seems to be able to handle everything.

ctx.x: Marl is running for President of the Union. I don't know if you know that.
Yes. He made the front page of Variety. I mean, I saw it in Overture, but Variety scooped Overture. Overture being Local 47's monthly newspaper.
